about: Country cards for lives born in United Kingdom. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== United Kingdom (GB) ===================== Plan 5 student loans (England, from Aug 2023): 9% of income above £25,000, interest at RPI, written off after 40 years (GOV.UK, as summarised by Whitings LLP and uktax.tools). £25,000 in game money (÷ 0.633, PPP) ≈ 1.41 typical wages.

opts.do: sloanR = 0; sloanInc = { r: .09, th: 1.41, end: age + 40 }

en..x: Your student loan ({a}, Plan 5) is repaid through your payslip: 9% of everything you earn above £25,000 a year. Interest follows inflation (RPI), and whatever is left 40 years later is written off.
en..pay: Let payroll take care of it
en..pay.s: About {a} a year at your pay now; more as your pay rises.

zh..x: 你的学生贷款（{a}，第5类方案）从薪水里扣还：年收入超过£25,000的部分扣9%。利息跟着通胀（RPI）走，40年后剩下的全部免除。
zh..pay.s: 以现在的收入每年约{a}；收入越高扣越多。

zht..x: 你的學生貸款（{a}，第5類方案）從薪水裡扣還：年收入超過£25,000的部分扣9%。利息跟著通膨（RPI）走，40年後剩下的全部免除。
zht..pay.s: 以現在的收入每年約{a}；收入越高扣越多。

events.src: Lifetime ISA: open from 18 to 39, save up to £4,000 a year with a 25% government bonus (max £1,000); for a first home up to £450,000 or after 60, otherwise a 25% withdrawal charge (GOV.UK; MoneyHelper).

opts.do: yearly('lisa', { amt: a, until: 50, bonus: .25 }, { lock: 60 }, 'trk.lisa')

en..x: Open a Lifetime ISA before 40: save up to £4,000 a year and the government adds 25%. It can buy a first home costing £450,000 or less, or be spent after 60; take it out for anything else and 25% is charged.
en..lisa.s: About {a} a year; the government adds {b}.
en..isa.s: About {a} a year, tax-free, with no bonus and no lock.

zh..x: 40岁前可以开终身个人储蓄账户（Lifetime ISA）：每年最多存£4,000，政府再加25%。可以用来买£450,000以下的首套房，或在60岁后使用；其他用途提取要扣25%。
zh..isa.s: 每年约{a}，免税，没有奖励金也不锁定。

zht..x: 40歲前可以開終身個人儲蓄帳戶（Lifetime ISA）：每年最多存£4,000，政府再加25%。可以用來買£450,000以下的首套房，或在60歲後使用；其他用途提取要扣25%。
zht..isa.s: 每年約{a}，免稅，沒有獎勵金也不鎖定。

events.src: Workplace pension: automatic enrolment with a minimum of 8% of qualifying earnings, at least 3% from the employer (The Pensions Regulator); normal minimum pension age 57 from 2028 (HMRC).

en..x: You’ve been automatically enrolled in a workplace pension: at least 5% of your qualifying pay goes in (tax relief included) and your employer adds at least 3%. You can opt out and keep the 5% as pay.
en..stay.s: {a} a year from your pay; your employer adds {b}. Locked until 57.
en..more.s: {a} a year from your pay; your employer still adds {b}.
en..out.s: About {a} more take-home pay a year.

zh..x: 你被自动加入职场养老金：至少5%的合格薪资存进去（含税务减免），雇主至少再加3%。你可以退出，把5%留作薪水。
zh..stay.s: 每年从薪水扣{a}，雇主再加{b}。锁到57岁。
zh..more.s: 每年从薪水扣{a}，雇主仍加{b}。

zht..x: 你被自動加入職場退休金：至少5%的合格薪資存進去（含稅務減免），僱主至少再加3%。你可以退出，把5%留作薪水。
zht..stay.s: 每年從薪水扣{a}，僱主再加{b}。鎖到57歲。
zht..more.s: 每年從薪水扣{a}，僱主仍加{b}。

events.src: NHS waits: 7.41 million waiting pathways in August 2025, with 61% waiting under 18 weeks (NHS England RTT statistics, via Health Care and Protection). A private knee replacement at about £13,500 ≈ 0.76 of the game's typical wage: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You need a knee replacement. The NHS will do it for free, but about 7.4 million cases were waiting in England in 2025, and almost 4 in 10 had waited more than 18 weeks. A private hospital charges around £12,000–15,000.
en..wait.s: Free, but months of pain first, and time off work. Happiness −4.

zh..x: 你需要换膝关节。NHS免费帮你做，但2025年英格兰约有740万个案例在排队，近四成等了18周以上。私立医院收费约£12,000–15,000。
zh..wait.s: 免费，但要先痛好几个月，还要请假。幸福感 −4。
zh..private.s: 约{a}{ins}。几周内就动手术。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 你需要換膝關節。NHS免費幫你做，但2025年英格蘭約有740萬個案例在排隊，近四成等了18周以上。私立醫院收費約£12,000–15,000。
zht..wait.s: 免費，但要先痛好幾個月，還要請假。幸福感 −4。
zht..private.s: 約{a}{ins}。幾周內就動手術。幸福感 +1。

events.src: Shared Ownership: buy a 10–75% share with a mortgage and pay rent (usually up to 2.75–3% of the unsold share's value a year) to a housing association (GOV.UK Shared Ownership).

opts.ok: liq >= .12 * Sh || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.12 * Sh), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(Sh, { dp: .1, fee: .02, r: .03, n: 30, lk: 'trk.gb_shared', frac: 1 }); T('gb_soRent', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.gb_soRent') }); rec('gb_soRent', .0165 * P, 30)

en..x: With Shared Ownership you buy part of a home (10% to 75%) with a mortgage and pay rent to a housing association on the rest, usually up to 3% of its value a year. You can buy more later. A home near you costs {p}.
en..share.s: {d} up front and {m} a year on the mortgage, plus {r} a year in rent on the rest.

zh..x: 共有产权让你用房贷买下房子的一部分（10%到75%），其余部分付租金给住房协会，通常每年不超过那部分价值的3%。之后可以再买更多份额。你附近一间房子要{p}。
zh..share.s: 首付{d}，房贷每年{m}，其余部分每年租金{r}。

zht..x: 共有產權讓你用房貸買下房子的一部分（10%到75%），其餘部分付租金給住房協會，通常每年不超過那部分價值的3%。之後可以再買更多份額。你附近一間房子要{p}。
zht..share.s: 頭期款{d}，房貸每年{m}，其餘部分每年租金{r}。

events.src: Childcare in England: 30 hours a week of funded childcare in term time for working parents of children from 9 months, from September 2025 (Department for Education; Working Families). Costs of extra hours are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('gb_cc', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycare') }); rec('gb_cc', .1 * B, 4)
T('gb_cc', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycareF') }); rec('gb_cc', .03 * B, 4)

en..x: Since September 2025, working parents in England can get 30 hours a week of free childcare in term time, from when a child is 9 months old. Extra hours, meals and holidays you pay for yourselves.
en..both.s: Extras cost about {a} a year for 4 years.
en..part.s: About 40% less pay for 4 years (16 hours a week or more keeps the free hours). Happiness +2.
en..family.s: You help with their costs: about {a} a year.

zh..x: 从2025年9月起，英格兰的在职父母在孩子满9个月后，学期内每周可享30小时免费托儿。额外的时数、餐费和假期要自己付。
zh..part.s: 4年内工资少约40%（每周至少16小时才保得住免费时数）。幸福感 +2。
zh..family.s: 你帮忙负担他们的开销：每年约{a}。

zht..x: 從2025年9月起，英格蘭的在職父母在孩子滿9個月後，學期內每週可享30小時免費托育。額外的時數、餐費和假期要自己付。
zht..part.s: 4年內薪水少約40%（每週至少16小時才保得住免費時數）。幸福感 +2。
zht..family.s: 你幫忙負擔他們的開銷：每年約{a}。

events.src: National Insurance gaps: the full new State Pension is £230.25 a week in 2025/26 and needs 35 qualifying years; a voluntary Class 3 year costs £923 and adds about £342 a year (1/35 of the full rate) (Which?, 2025). In game money a year costs ≈ 0.052 and adds ≈ 0.019 a year; three missing years.

opts.do: pay(.156 * B); penScheme('gb_ni', 0, 0, .058 * B, 67); const t = trk.gb_ni; t.v -= .156 * B; t.paid = .156 * B

en..x: Your National Insurance record has three missing years from time abroad or out of work. The full new State Pension (£230.25 a week in 2025/26) needs 35 qualifying years. Each missing year costs £923 to fill and adds about £342 a year to your pension, for life.
en..fill.s: Pay {a} now for about {b} more pension a year from 67.

zh..x: 因为出国或没工作，你的国民保险记录少了三年。全额新国家养老金（2025/26年度每周£230.25）需要35个合格年。每补一年要£923，之后每年多领约£342，终身领取。
zh..fill.s: 现在付{a}，67岁起每年多领约{b}的养老金。

zht..x: 因為出國或沒工作，你的國民保險記錄少了三年。全額新國家退休金（2025/26年度每週£230.25）需要35個合格年。每補一年要£923，之後每年多領約£342，終身領取。
zht..fill.s: 現在付{a}，67歲起每年多領約{b}的退休金。

events.src: Premium Bonds: a 3.60% prize fund rate until April 2026, then 3.30% with odds of 23,000 to 1 per £1 bond; prizes tax-free (NS&I press release, Feb 2026). With UK inflation near 3.5%, about 0% in today's money; a cash ISA about 0.5%: ESTIMATES.

en..x: With Premium Bonds your savings are safe with NS&I, and instead of interest each £1 bond enters a monthly prize draw. The prize fund rate was 3.6% in 2025 and 3.3% from April 2026; prizes are tax-free, but most bonds win nothing in most months. You have {a} to put somewhere.
en..bonds.s: Move {a} in. Over the years, about the same as inflation.
en..cash.s: Move {a} in. About 0.5% a year after inflation.

zh..x: 有奖债券（Premium Bonds）由国家储蓄投资局担保，不付利息，而是每1英镑债券参加每月抽奖。2025年奖金池利率为3.6%，2026年4月起为3.3%；奖金免税，但大多数债券大多数月份什么都没抽中。你有{a}要找地方放。
zh..bonds.s: 放入{a}。长期下来大约和通胀持平。
zh..cash.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀后每年约0.5%。

zht..x: 有獎債券（Premium Bonds）由國家儲蓄投資局擔保，不付利息，而是每1英鎊債券參加每月抽獎。2025年獎金池利率為3.6%，2026年4月起為3.3%；獎金免稅，但大多數債券大多數月份什麼都沒抽中。你有{a}要找地方放。
zht..bonds.s: 放入{a}。長期下來大約和通膨持平。
zht..cash.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨後每年約0.5%。

events.src: Higher-rate pension saving: income tax is 40% on pay above £50,270 in 2025-26, a threshold frozen until 2031 (HMRC; Autumn Budget, Nov 2025). Salary sacrifice also saves employee National Insurance; from April 2029 only the first £2,000 a year sacrificed stays free of National Insurance (Autumn Budget 2025). Pensions can be drawn from 57 from 2028 (HMRC). The tax relief after the tax paid on drawing it (about 50% on top) is an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

en..x: Your pay is now in the 40% tax band. HR explains that if you give up part of your salary, the company pays it straight into your pension, so you save the income tax and National Insurance on it.
en..ss.s: About {a} a year of your pay goes into the pension instead. Locked until 57.
en..ss.h: Tax relief adds about 50% on top, after the tax you pay when you draw it.
en..no: Keep your pay as it is
en..no.s: You pay tax on all of it now.

zh..x: 你的薪水已经进了40%的税率档。人事部说，只要放弃一部分薪水，公司就把这笔钱直接存进你的养老金，你就能省下这部分的所得税和国民保险。
zh..ss.s: 每年大约{a}的薪水改存进养老金。57岁前不能动用。
zh..ss.h: 扣掉将来领取时要缴的税，税务减免大约再多给50%。

zht..x: 你的薪水已經進了40%的稅率級距。人資部說，只要放棄一部分薪水，公司就把這筆錢直接存進你的退休金，你就能省下這部分的所得稅和國民保險。
zht..ss.s: 每年大約{a}的薪水改存進退休金。57歲前不能動用。
zht..ss.h: 扣掉將來領取時要繳的稅，稅務減免大約再多給50%。

events.src: Contracting: since April 2021, medium and large private-sector clients decide whether a contract falls inside IR35, in which case the contractor is taxed like an employee (HMRC off-payroll working rules). Day rates, gaps between contracts and the pay effects are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

en..x: A recruiter offers you a six-month contract through your own limited company, at a day rate worth far more than your salary. No sick pay, no holiday pay, no employer pension.
en..go: Set up a company and go
en..go.s: A day rate instead of a salary; you find the next contract yourself.
en..go.h: Pay about 35% higher for five years, but more gaps between jobs; Happiness +1.
en..stay.s: A salary, sick pay and a pension.

zh..x: 猎头给你一份为期六个月的合约，要你开一家自己的有限公司来接，日薪比你现在的薪水高很多。没有病假工资、没有带薪假，也没有雇主养老金。
zh..go.s: 领日薪而不是月薪；下一份合约得自己找。
zh..go.h: 五年内收入高约35%，但空窗期更多；幸福感 +1。
zh..stay.s: 有月薪、病假工资和养老金。

zht..x: 獵頭給你一份為期六個月的合約，要你開一家自己的有限公司來接，日薪比你現在的薪水高很多。沒有病假薪資、沒有特休，也沒有雇主提撥的退休金。
zht..go.s: 領日薪而不是月薪；下一份合約得自己找。
zht..go.h: 五年內收入高約35%，但空窗期更多；幸福感 +1。
zht..stay.s: 有月薪、病假薪資和退休金。

events.src: IR35: inside IR35, tax and National Insurance are taken as if you were an employee, without employee rights (HMRC). Effects are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your client has decided your contract falls inside IR35. From next month, tax and National Insurance come off your day rate as if you were an employee, but you still get no holiday or sick pay.
en..accept.s: The same work, less take-home pay.
en..accept.h: Pay about 20% lower for two years; Happiness −1.
en..hunt: Look for a client outside IR35
en..hunt.h: Half the time it takes months to find one; Happiness −1.

zh..x: 客户判定你的合约适用IR35。从下个月起，你的日薪要像员工一样扣所得税和国民保险，可你还是没有带薪假和病假工资。
zh..accept.s: 工作一样，到手的钱变少。
zh..accept.h: 两年内收入低约20%；幸福感 −1。
zh..hunt.s: 有些中介还有这种合约。
zh..hunt.h: 有一半的机会要找上好几个月；幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 客戶認定你的合約適用IR35。從下個月起，你的日薪要像員工一樣扣所得稅和國民保險，可是你還是沒有特休和病假薪資。
zht..accept.s: 工作一樣，到手的錢變少。
zht..accept.h: 兩年內收入低約20%；幸福感 −1。
zht..hunt.s: 有些仲介還有這種合約。
zht..hunt.h: 有一半的機會要找上好幾個月；幸福感 −1。

events.src: Car finance: about nine in ten private new-car purchases in the UK are financed, mostly through Personal Contract Purchase (Finance & Leasing Association). PCP payments (about £350 a month ≈ 0.24 a year) and used-car prices are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

opts.do: T('gb_pcp', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.gb_pcp') }); rec('gb_pcp', .24 * base, 4); happy += 3

en..x: The dealer’s offer: a new hatchback for a small deposit and a monthly payment. After four years you can hand it back, pay the final balloon payment, or swap it for another new car.
en..pcp.s: About {a} a year for four years, then hand it back or pay the balloon.
en..pcp.h: Happiness +3; at the end you own nothing unless you pay the balloon.
en..used: A used car, paid in cash
en..none.s: A bus pass and the odd taxi.

zh..x: 车行的方案：付一点订金再按月付款，就能开走一辆新的掀背车。四年后可以还车、付最后一笔尾款买下，或是换一辆新车。
zh..pcp.s: 四年内每年大约{a}，之后还车或付尾款。
zh..pcp.h: 幸福感 +3；最后不付尾款的话，车就不是你的。

zht..x: 車商的方案：付一點訂金再按月付款，就能開走一輛新的掀背車。四年後可以還車、付最後一筆尾款買下，或是換一輛新車。
zht..pcp.s: 四年內每年大約{a}，之後還車或付尾款。
zht..pcp.h: 幸福感 +3；最後不付尾款的話，車子就不是你的。
zht..none.s: 靠公車月票，偶爾搭計程車。

events.src: Motor finance redress: after finding that commission paid to dealers was not properly disclosed, the FCA set up a redress scheme in March 2026 for agreements from 2007 to 2024: about 12.1 million eligible agreements and an average payment of about £829 (≈ 0.047) (FCA PS26/3, via Slaughter and May and Mayer Brown). Claiming is free; the FCA has warned that claims firms can take a large share, up to about 30% (FCA). The fee used is an ESTIMATE.

en..t: A letter about your car finance
en..x: Your old car finance company writes: the dealer’s commission wasn’t properly disclosed, and under the FCA’s redress scheme you are owed compensation. A claims firm has also texted, offering to handle it for you.
en..firm: Let the claims firm handle it

zh..x: 以前的车贷公司来信说，车行拿的佣金当初没有好好告知你，依照金融行为监管局的赔偿方案，你可以拿到补偿。另外有一家索赔公司发短信来，说可以帮你办。

zht..x: 以前的車貸公司來信說，車商拿的佣金當初沒有好好告知你，依照金融行為監理局的賠償方案，你可以拿到補償。另外有一家索賠公司傳簡訊來，說可以幫你辦。

events.src: Degree apprenticeships: you work for an employer and study for a bachelor’s degree with no tuition fees, which the employer and the apprenticeship levy pay (GOV.UK). University tuition fees in England are up to £9,535 a year in 2025-26 (DfE). There were 353,500 apprenticeship starts at all levels in England in 2024-25 (House of Commons Library). Places are competitive; pay while training (about £20,000 ≈ 1.1) and the skill gained are an ESTIMATE. Choosing it counts as a degree, so the card at 18 is skipped. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

opts.do: done.edu = 'uni'; const lab = M('lbl.gb_app'); study = { end: age + 4, gain: 5.5 * learnLuck('gb_app'), pt: 1.1, label: lab, k: 'uni' }; T('sk_edu', { kind: 'skill', label: lab })

en..x: Instead of going to university, you could apply for a degree apprenticeship: four years working for an employer while you study for the same bachelor’s degree, with no tuition fees. University fees in England are up to £9,535 a year.
en..app.s: Paid about {a} a year while you train, and no student loan.
en..app.h: Skill +5.5 a year for 4 years; it counts as a degree.
en..need: Places are competitive, and your grades aren’t high enough.
en..uni.s: Then choose between university, college and work.

zh..x: 除了上大学，你也可以申请学位学徒制：一边在公司工作四年，一边读同样的学士学位，而且不用学费。英格兰的大学学费一年最高9,535英镑。
zh..app.s: 受训期间每年大约{a}的薪水，也不用背学贷。
zh..app.h: 四年内每年能力 +5.5；算作大学学历。
zh..need: 名额竞争激烈，你的成绩不够。
zh..uni.s: 接着在大学、专科和工作之间选。

zht..x: 除了上大學，你也可以申請學位學徒制：一邊在公司工作四年，一邊讀同樣的學士學位，而且不用學費。英格蘭的大學學費一年最高9,535英鎊。
zht..app.s: 受訓期間每年大約{a}的薪水，也不用背學貸。
zht..app.h: 四年內每年能力 +5.5；算作大學學歷。
zht..need: 名額競爭激烈，你的成績不夠。
zht..uni.s: 接著在大學、專科和工作之間選。

events.src: Help to Save: people on Universal Credit with earnings can save up to £50 a month for four years and get a 50% government bonus, up to £1,200 (GOV.UK); the scheme runs to at least April 2027. £600 a year (≈ 0.034) and who qualifies here are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

opts.do: yearly('gb_hts', { amt: .034 * base, until: age + 4, bonus: .5 }, { rate: 0 }, 'trk.gb_hts')

en..x: Because you get Universal Credit, you can open a Help to Save account: put in up to £50 a month for four years and the government adds 50% on top.
en..save: Open one and save £50 a month
en..save.s: About {a} a year for four years.
en..save.h: The bonus adds half of what you save.

zh..x: 因为你领综合救济金，可以开一个“帮你存钱”账户：四年内每月最多存50英镑，政府再加给你50%。
zh..save.h: 奖励金是你存的钱的一半。

zht..x: 因為你領綜合救助金，可以開一個「幫你存錢」帳戶：四年內每月最多存50英鎊，政府再加給你50%。
zht..save.h: 獎勵金是你存的錢的一半。

events.src: Debt solutions in England and Wales: an Individual Voluntary Arrangement is a legally binding deal to repay what you can afford, usually over five years, after which the rest is written off; a Debt Relief Order covers debts up to £50,000 for people with little income or assets, and has had no fee since April 2024 (Insolvency Service, GOV.UK). Both stay on your credit file for six years. The share repaid and who qualifies here are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

opts.do: const x = debt; debt = 0; T('gb_iva', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.gb_iva') }); rec('gb_iva', .1 * x, 5); happy += 3

en..x: Your debts have reached {a}, and the interest is outrunning your payments. A free debt charity explains your options.
en..iva.s: Pay about {a} a year for five years; the rest is written off.
en..iva.h: Happiness +3; your credit file shows it for six years.
en..dro.s: No fee; for people with a low income and few assets.
en..dro.h: Happiness +4; the debts are written off after a year.

zh..x: 你的债务已经到了{a}，利息涨得比你还得还快。一家免费的债务咨询慈善机构向你说明了几种办法。
zh..iva.s: 五年内每年还大约{a}，剩下的一笔勾销。
zh..iva.h: 幸福感 +3；信用记录上会留六年。
zh..dro.s: 不收费；适用于收入低、资产少的人。
zh..dro.h: 幸福感 +4；一年后债务一笔勾销。
zh..pay.s: 照现在这样付最低还款。

zht..x: 你的債務已經到了{a}，利息漲得比你還得還快。一家免費的債務諮詢慈善機構向你說明了幾種辦法。
zht..iva.s: 五年內每年還大約{a}，剩下的一筆勾銷。
zht..iva.h: 幸福感 +3；信用紀錄上會留六年。
zht..dro.s: 不收費；適用於收入低、資產少的人。
zht..dro.h: 幸福感 +4；一年後債務一筆勾銷。
zht..pay.s: 照現在這樣付最低還款。

events.src: Inheritance tax: 40% on estates above the £325,000 nil-rate band, plus up to £175,000 more when a home goes to children, both frozen until at least 2030 (HMRC); gifts are free of inheritance tax if you live seven more years. The game doesn’t charge the tax; the gift’s effect on Happiness and closeness is a game rule (ESTIMATE). Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

give.do: pay(x); const t = T('gb_gift', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.gb_gift') }); t.v -= x; t.note = M('note.gb_gift', { a: MN(x) })

en..x: Your accountant points out that inheritance tax takes 40% of what you leave above £325,000, but gifts are tax-free if you live another seven years. Your children are raising families of their own.
en..give: Give them a large gift now
en..give.h: Happiness +3; you grow closer to your children.
en..small.h: Happiness +1; a little closer to your children.
en..keep.s: You might need it for care.

zh..x: 会计师提醒你，你留下的遗产超过32.5万英镑的部分要缴40%的遗产税，但只要赠与后再活满七年，赠与就免税。你的孩子们都在养自己的家了。
zh..small.h: 幸福感 +1；和孩子亲近一些。
zh..keep.s: 说不定以后要用来请人照顾。

zht..x: 會計師提醒你，你留下的遺產超過32.5萬英鎊的部分要繳40%的遺產稅，但只要贈與後再活滿七年，贈與就免稅。你的孩子們都在養自己的家了。
zht..small.h: 幸福感 +1；和孩子親近一些。
zht..keep.s: 說不定以後要用來請人照顧。

events.src: Junior ISA: up to £9,000 a year, invested free of tax; the money belongs to the child, who takes control of it at 18 (HMRC; the allowance stays at £9,000 until at least 2031, Autumn Budget 2025). The yearly amount is an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

opts.do: yearly('gb_jisa', { amt: .04 * base, until: 18 - p.d }, {}, 'trk.gb_jisa'); next('gb_jisa2', 18 - age - p.d, {})

en..x: You could open a Junior ISA for {p}: up to £9,000 a year, invested tax-free. At 18 the money becomes theirs to spend as they like.
en..yes: Open one and pay in every month
en..yes.s: About {a} a year until they turn 18.
en..yes.h: Invested in shares; at 18 it all goes to your child.
en..no.s: You will save for them your own way.

zh..x: 你可以替{p}开一个儿童免税储蓄账户（Junior ISA）：每年最多存9,000英镑，投资免税。到了18岁，这笔钱就归孩子，爱怎么用就怎么用。
zh..yes.h: 投资股票；18岁时全部归孩子。
zh..no.s: 你会用自己的方式替孩子存钱。

zht..x: 你可以替{p}開一個兒童免稅儲蓄帳戶（Junior ISA）：每年最多存9,000英鎊，投資免稅。到了18歲，這筆錢就歸孩子，愛怎麼用就怎麼用。
zht..yes.h: 投資股票；18歲時全部歸孩子。
zht..no.s: 你會用自己的方式替孩子存錢。

events.src: Junior ISA: at 18 the account becomes an adult ISA in the child’s name, and they decide what to do with it (HMRC). Effects are a game rule.

hand.do: const l = lots.gb_jisa; l.tout += l.v; l.v = 0; stopYearly('gb_jisa'); bond('kid', b)

en..x: Your child has turned 18, and the Junior ISA, now worth {a}, is theirs. They are thinking about buying a car.
en..talk: Talk them into saving it for a home
en..talk.s: It’s their decision, but they listen.
en..talk.h: The money leaves your savings; closeness +3.
en..free.s: A car, a trip or a deposit: their call.
en..free.h: The money leaves your savings; closeness +5, Happiness +1.

zh..x: 孩子满18岁了，那个现在值{a}的储蓄账户归孩子了。孩子正在考虑买车。
zh..talk.s: 决定权在孩子，但孩子听进去了。
zh..talk.h: 这笔钱离开你的账户；亲近度 +3。
zh..free.s: 买车、旅行还是存首付，由孩子决定。
zh..free.h: 这笔钱离开你的账户；亲近度 +5，幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 孩子滿18歲了，那個現在值{a}的儲蓄帳戶歸孩子了。孩子正在考慮買車。
zht..talk.s: 決定權在孩子，但孩子聽進去了。
zht..talk.h: 這筆錢離開你的帳戶；親近度 +3。
zht..free.s: 買車、旅行還是存頭期款，由孩子決定。
zht..free.h: 這筆錢離開你的帳戶；親近度 +5，幸福感 +1。

events.src: Working in Dubai: the UAE has no personal income tax on salaries (UAE Ministry of Finance), and around 240,000 British nationals live there (FCDO estimate). The pay rise, the higher rents and school fees and the length of the contract are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

en..x: A firm in Dubai offers you a three-year contract at about {a} a year, with no income tax. Rents and school fees there are steep.

zh..x: 迪拜一家公司给你一份三年合约，年薪大约{a}，而且不用缴所得税。不过那里的房租和学费都很贵。

zht..x: 杜拜一家公司給你一份三年合約，年薪大約{a}，而且不用繳所得稅。不過那裡的房租和學費都很貴。

events.src: Renters’ Rights Act 2025: Section 21 ‘no-fault’ evictions ended in England on 1 May 2026; a landlord who wants to sell can still end a tenancy after the first year with four months’ notice (GOV.UK; Shelter). Rents for new lets, moving costs and the discount when buying from the landlord are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in the United Kingdom, about £17,700 a year (28,000 PPP dollars × 0.633).

opts.do: spend('gb_mv', .05 * base, 'trk.gb_mv'); T('gb_rent', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.gb_rent') }); rec('gb_rent', .04 * base, 5)
spend('gb_mv', .05 * base, 'trk.gb_mv'); T('gb_far', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.gb_far') }); rec('gb_far', -.04 * base, 5, -.3); happy -= 1

en..x: Your landlord is selling the flat and has given you four months’ notice. Rents for new lets nearby have gone up since you moved in. The landlord would sell it to you first, if you can get a mortgage.
en..buy: Buy the flat from your landlord
en..buy.s: A deposit and fees of about {a}.
en..buy.h: No estate agent: about 5% under the market price.
en..near.s: About {a} to move, and a higher rent.
en..near.h: The rent stays higher for the next five years.
en..far.s: About {a} to move; a cheaper rent and a longer commute.
en..far.h: Rent saved, but Health a little lower each year and Happiness −1.

zh..x: 房东要卖掉这套公寓，给了你四个月的通知。你搬进来之后，附近新出租的房子都涨价了。房东说，如果你申请得到房贷，可以优先卖给你。
zh..buy.h: 不经过中介：比市价便宜约5%。
zh..near.h: 之后五年房租都比较高。
zh..far.s: 搬家大约{a}；房租便宜，但通勤更远。
zh..far.h: 省下房租，但健康每年少一点，幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 房東要賣掉這間公寓，給了你四個月的通知。你搬進來之後，附近新出租的房子都漲價了。房東說，如果你申請得到房貸，可以優先賣給你。
zht..buy.h: 不經過仲介：比市價便宜約5%。
zht..near.h: 之後五年房租都比較高。
zht..far.s: 搬家大約{a}；房租便宜，但通勤更遠。
zht..far.h: 省下房租，但健康每年少一點，幸福感 −1。
